name: Kalki
note: Suspended: an avatar with no ancestry, floated beside the close of the Kali age

Kalki.note: The twenty-second and last: to be born to Vishnu Yasha in the village of Shambhala at the joint of two ages, when the kings have all turned to plunder, and to ride out on a white horse with a sword like a comet. The only avatar in this tree who has not happened. SB 1.3.25, 12.2
